about: fk-engine's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk6-stop-stays
mutants.rule: A stop ends the entry that holds the lease, so the engine is released (law ReleasesEqualAcquires).

mutants.name: fk6-started-enters
mutants.from: Stay[Mode]{Next: Ready{Engine: st.Engine, Computed: 0, Last: None}}
mutants.to: Enter[Mode]{Next: Ready{Engine: st.Engine, Computed: 0, Last: None}}
mutants.rule: Ready keeps the boot's entry, and with it the lease (law ReleasesEqualAcquires).

mutants.name: fk6-ready-reboots
mutants.rule: A start while ready boots nothing (law OneBootPerStart).

mutants.name: fk6-square-of-the-old-count
mutants.rule: A compute squares the next count (law ComputeNeedsAnEngine).

mutants.name: fk6-lease-not-held
mutants.rule: The boot's work holds the lease until its entry ends (law ReleasesEqualAcquires).

mutants.name: fk6-failed-stays-failed
mutants.rule: A start after a failed boot boots again (case engine).

mutants.name: fk6-pool-one-id
mutants.rule: Engines held at once are distinct engines (law Engines.HeldEnginesAreDistinct).

mutants.name: fk6-release-uncounted
mutants.rule: Every lease's end gives its engine back (law ReleasesEqualAcquires).

mutants.name: fk6-fault-ignored
mutants.rule: A fault fails the next boot (case engine).
